helpIntro: A few simple steps can make a leaf photo easier to check.
chooseLeafFocus: Choose one cassava leaf. Make sure the leaf is in focus.
daylightAvoidShadows: Daylight helps. Avoid shadows and very dark photos.
compareAndAsk: Compare the signs with your plant. Ask an expert if you are unsure.
canCheckText: This version is designed to recognize five cassava leaf classes: bacterial blight, brown streak disease, green mottle, mosaic disease, and healthy-looking leaves.
cannotDoText: It cannot confirm every disease, identify other crops, or inspect roots. It may be wrong, especially with unclear photos or symptoms not covered by the model. A low score means “Not sure,” not that a plant is healthy.
photoPrivateText: The model runs in this browser. Photos are not uploaded. If you save a result, only a small preview is kept on this device.
helpDisclaimer: PlantPulse is a decision-support tool. It is not a substitute for an agronomist or extension officer. For a fast-spreading problem or major crop loss, ask a local extension officer.
aboutIntro: Technical information about this browser and the local diagnosis model.
aboutAccuracy: The classifier runs on your device using TensorFlow.js. Results are guidance, not confirmed diagnoses. The current trained model scored 70.98% accuracy on its held-out test set; performance can vary in real fields.
aboutPrivacy: No account is needed for diagnosis. Photos are not uploaded. Inference time depends on this device and its browser.
